sources.title: Yi-1.5
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The Yi-1.5 repository documents 34B/9B/6B variants, local use including Ollama, fine-tuning ecosystem integrations, and Apache-2.0 code/weights with attribution guidance.

limitations.text: The Yi-1.5 repository alone cannot prove the absence of a later independent general Yi frontier endpoint; that negative conclusion remains a Discovery-level catalog observation.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Verify Yi-1.5 release, open/local deployment, fine-tuning integrations, licensing, and whether an official later general Yi endpoint exists within the as-of boundary.
targets.finding: The repository verifies Yi-1.5 release/deployment/fine-tuning/licensing; the absence of a later co-equal general endpoint is not established by this source alone and remains contextual.
